headline: Puppet RCE now exploited; Java4Shell (CVE-2026-114938) threatens Jira, Jenkins, Keycloak; Microsoft Agent Framework PyPI package poisoned

bullets.text: New, critical: the Perforce Puppet RCE (CVE-2026-115731) is now exploited in attacks, per SecurityWeek and The Hacker News. It entered CISA KEV on 11-17 with a federal due date of 12-01.

Developing, critical: Java4Shell (CVE-2026-114938), now 8 outlets. The Hacker News says it enables pre-auth RCE in Jira, Jenkins, Keycloak and more; CISA urges immediate patching. Help Net Security says exploitation is tricky and hinges on specific CPUs.

New supply-chain attack: malicious pip releases agent-framework 1.26.1 and 1.26.2. SecurityWeek and The Hacker News say Microsoft Agent Framework releases were poisoned with a credential stealer targeting cloud credentials.
New, critical: Apache warns its Roller RCE vulnerability is exploited in attacks, per BleepingComputer. No CVE or fixed version is given in the brief.

Still active: Optimizely (7 outlets) confirmed malicious code in customer sites; Krebs says attackers used it to A/B test malware on top websites. Uber's third-party breach (~150,000 people) and the Fugaku supercomputer attack remain on the board.

Also new: a cyberattack disrupted internal services at Equinor; Russian COLD RELIC used stolen Google Workspace data to breach a second US organization. SITCON 3 unchanged; 7-day score 0.8x the 90-day average; n0n (78) leads leak-site claims.

actions: Search environments and lockfiles for pip agent-framework 1.26.1 or 1.26.2; remove them and rotate cloud credentials on any host that installed them.
Puppet Enterprise admins: apply the fix for CVE-2026-115731 now (exploited, KEV due 12-01) and restrict network access to the Puppet server.
Inventory Java runtimes and Java apps such as Jira, Jenkins and Keycloak; apply Oracle and vendor fixes for Java4Shell (CVE-2026-114938) as CISA urges.
Apache Roller users: follow Apache's advisory and restrict internet access to Roller until patched.
Optimizely users: audit Optimizely snippets and third-party scripts on your sites for unexpected changes.
Queue KEV fixes: SonicWall SSLVPN CVE-2026-19868 due 11-20; Outlook, Cisco BroadWorks, Openwave and Chromium due 11-24.
